name: design-superpowers
description: An autonomous agentic design framework for visual design, UX, branding, editorial, and conversion-focused deliverables with evidence-based validation and multi-agent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous design agents with validation loops for landing pages, branding, presentations, and editorial design
interface.longDescription: Design Superpowers provides a multi-agent architecture for design work: Orchestrator coordinates, Art Director sets visual direction, UX Designer architects experience, Web Builder implements in Elementor/HTML/Figma, Brand Designer develops identity systems, Sales Specialist optimizes conversion, and Design Critic independently audits with evidence-based validators (contrast, accessibility, performance, visual regression, responsive, conversion). Features design loops with auto-correction, staging-only builds, and token-governed design systems.
defaultPrompt: I need a landing page that converts for my B2B service.
Design a brand identity system for my company.
Create an executive presentation from this brief.
Audit this design for accessibility and conversion.
